name: Narumi Subaru
source:
One of your childhood friends. High school senior.
He lives with his grandparents and looks after his twin brother and sister. He’s usually calm and gentle, but sometimes he makes scathing comments and is scary when angered. Loves games and spends all his time playing them when he’s alone.

‘Don’t worry. We’ll always be together from now on.’

[Translated from [url=https://animal-pla.net/hoshikuzu/]the official website[/url].]
